verdict.rationale: Kimi's own help center lists 'memory' (记忆) among the assistant's general features alongside search, scheduled tasks and skills, so a first-party memory capability exists. Nothing in the evidence describes how it works, or confirms that it carries context across chats into new conversations. The million-token context window and file-based QA are within-session features and do not count toward cross-chat memory. Missing for 10: documentation of persistent cross-conversation memory, how relevant past context is recalled and applied in new chats, user controls for viewing or editing memories, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant remember relevant context from previous chats and apply it in new conversations

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
